# mirrorbot -- mirror bot (episode 1 mirror walker, box 24 x 40, faces right)
# generated by tools/sprites/build.py -- do not edit by hand
# anchor = bottom centre of the box (feet on the ground line)
# the mirror faces forward: plain shots from the front glance back (engine)
# glow: magenta visor, cyan mirror edge, teal beacon, the glint
frame 64 64
anchor 32 60
# move: careful walk behind the mirror, contact at 0 and 4
anim move 12 loop 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7
# attack: the mirror thrust forward, a glint runs across it (a shot glances off)
anim attack 14 once 8 9 10 11 12 13
# idle: visor scans, the sheen drifts across the mirror
anim idle 8 loop 14 15 16 17 18 19
# hurt: jolted back, sparks
anim hurt 14 loop 20 21 22 23
